crossRefs.note: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also…
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ…
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

translations.web: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
translations.bsb: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
translations.kjv: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
translations.asv: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:
